comment: One line for all sixteen bars, eleven notes a bar: thumb on the root at the one, ghost at the and of 1, octave at the a of 1, root on 2, the octave pop on the and of 2, ghost at the a of 2, root on 3, fifth on the and of 3, octave at the a of 3, ghost at the e of 4, octave pop on the and of 4. Empty on the e of 1, the e of 2, the e of 3, the four and the a of 4 - the e of 3 is the kick's own, and the back half of the four is the guitar's. Root sits E2-A2 so the low end stays a bass, which puts the pops on E3, F#3 and A3 and therefore on the guitar's bottom voice on the F#m7 bars.
